scope: F14 Pen anchor-control reconciliation; complete roadmap remains active and incomplete

implementation.description: Long paths use memoized contiguous React control blocks without SVG wrappers; short paths render directly. Every native marker and original paint order remain. Block comparison includes coordinates, handles, basis, zoom, active anchor and length. Existing shared translation and large-coordinate precision fallback remain.
implementation.retention: Each block receives at most 64 point references, never the complete path array. This is an internal bounded-reference property, not a peak memory measurement.
implementation.boundaries: No command, model, schema, asset, plugin permission, scripting/REST API or import budget change.

for build,trial in [('baseline',1),('candidate',1),('candidate',2),('baseline',2),('baseline',3),('candidate',3)]:
 output=f'/tmp/canoli-pen-drag-paired-{build}-{trial}'
 env={**os.environ,'CANOLI_PEN_DRAG_FIXTURES':'/tmp/canoli-pen-drag-fixtures','CANOLI_PEN_DRAG_URL':f'http://127.0.0.1:{4183 if build=="baseline" else 4173}','CANOLI_PEN_DRAG_OUTPUT':output}
 with open(output+'.log','x') as log: subprocess.run(['node','--import','tsx','scripts/benchmark-pen-drag.mjs'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 r=json.load(open(pathlib.Path(output)/'report.json'))
 print(json.dumps({'build':build,'trial':trial,'results':[{ 'id':x['fixture']['id'],'p95':x['p95Ms'],'max':x['maxMs'],'longTasks':[t['duration'] for t in x['longTasks']]} for x in r['reports']]}),flush=True)
